title: Which storage class?
claim: How often the data is read, and how fast the first byte is needed, decide the storage class.
alt: A decision ladder with five questions. An unknown access pattern leads to S3 Intelligent-Tiering; reads more than once a month to S3 Standard; about once a month to S3 Standard-IA; quarterly reads in milliseconds to S3 Glacier Instant Retrieval; restores in minutes to S3 Glacier Flexible Retrieval; otherwise S3 Glacier Deep Archive.
